SecurityCraft-1.21.1-v1.10.1.jar.why: Removes its camera ChunkMap mixin, which crashes on world load next to Immersive Portals (needed by the Portal Gun).

farmersrespite-1.21.1-3.0.0-menufix.jar.why: Skips the second registration of its kettle menu, which crashes the game, and fixes its red dye recipe for 1.21.1.

ars_nouveau-1.21.1-5.13.0.jar.why: Leaves out its bundled LambDynamicLights API, which conflicts with the pack's mods.

randomizer-complete-edition-v0.6.jar.why: Fixes its crafting table recipe, which uses recipe syntax 1.21.1 can't read.

mob_mutator-1.0.0.jar.why: Removes its title screen mixin, which forces an editor button onto the pack's title screen.

fancymenu_neoforge_3.9.7_MC_1.21.1.jar.why: One-byte change that lets the pack's title screen lay out every button itself.

Structory_Towers_26.2_v1.0.17.jar.why: Declares it a data-only mod (lowcodefml), which NeoForge 1.21.1 needs to load it.

extract.why: The uranium A-10 uses MCHeli's own A-10 model, copied from the MCHeli jar on install.
